entries.name: Self-Employed Ledger for Microsoft Access
entries.identity_check: git clone of the URL; HEAD equals the pin and the blob SHAs match research/evidence.json. The archived flag was not rechecked because the GitHub REST API was not enabled for this repository in the session; prior research observed an archive date of 2021-01-27.

license.evidence: LICENSE at pin, read verbatim: Copyright (c) 2019 Ling X. Yang

entries.local_compatibility: The .accdt template declares RequiredAccessVersion 14 (Access 2010), AccessVersion 09.50, DataLocale 4105 (en-CA). VBA references: VBA, Access object library, stdole, the ACE DAO engine library (GUID 4AC9E1DA-...) and the Office library. It contains no Declare statements, so 32/64-bit pointer issues are not expected from VBA. Not opened in Access.
entries.offline_behaviour: No network calls, hyperlinks or external connections in the package members. It uses Scripting.FileSystemObject for local file reads and DAO for writes. There is no AutoExec macro and no StartUpForm.
entries.usable_role: Design reference for the 2b Access backend: a ledger plus an import-batch table with a statement period, lookup tables with unique name indexes, a Currency-typed amount, and a DAO BeginTrans/CommitTrans/Rollback import pattern.
inspected: All 47 package members listed; the members are XML/XSD/text, with no compiled database inside
8 table schemas (BankAccount, BankCSV, Category, Currency, ExpenseType, Ledger, Purpose, Tax): field types, nullability and indexes
relationships.xml: 8 relationships, 7 with referential integrity enforced (grbit 0) and TaxLedger not enforced (grbit 2)
formImportCSV and formLedgerInput definitions (UTF-16): record and row sources, event bindings
Sample data: none; no data XML members in the package
executed: Behavioural Python port of ParseCSVLine, the overlap criterion and the date build, run with synthetic cases (research/reuse/harness)
findings: The two buttons on the Import CSV form are bound to [Event Procedure], but the package contains no form class module, so the button code is absent from the template

Ledger.Taxes is a multi-valued field; Ledger.Receipt and BankCSV.CSVFile are Attachment fields. These complex types are poorly supported through ODBC, and the CSVFile attachment embeds raw bank statements in the database
The overlap check misses a new period that fully encloses an existing one (reproduced)
ParseCSVLine treats backslash as an escape character, which is not RFC 4180; a space after a closing quote, or a multi-line field, calls End, which stops all VBA (reproduced)
Dates are built as m/d/yyyy text and passed to CDate, which is locale-dependent (modelled); CDec is also locale-dependent
OpenTextFile is called with format 0 (ASCII), so UTF-8 descriptions may be mangled (static analysis)
bcsvID is declared as Integer, which overflows after 32767 imports (static analysis)
There is no per-transaction duplicate key, no statement/due-date/payment-allocation tables, and the categories are business/tax oriented
audit_gaps: Not instantiated in Access; whether the template still installs in Microsoft 365 Access is unverified
Whether Access can rebuild the missing form modules is unknown
Compile check against the user's Office bitness is pending

entries.name: Financial DashBoard (formerly WealthFinPilot)
entries.identity_check: git clone of the URL; HEAD equals the pin; the LICENSE, Automate.bas and Triage.bas blobs match research/evidence.json. The GitHub REST API was not available for repository metadata.

license.evidence: LICENSE at pin, read verbatim: Copyright (c) 2026 Sébastien Oger

entries.local_compatibility: Requires Excel 365 for Windows with macros (README). It has 63 ActiveX parts, PtrSafe and legacy Declare branches for user32/gdi32 (GDI drawing), French-language sheet and table names, and Power Query plus a Data Model.
entries.offline_behaviour: Power Query (M) reads only Excel.CurrentWorkbook(). FollowHyperlink is used for three Canadian/Quebec tax-information pages and there is one external worksheet hyperlink to statistique.quebec.ca; these are user-triggered browser links, not data fetches. No HTTP or XMLHTTP code and no Workbook_Open handler.
entries.usable_role: UI and dashboard pattern reference only: budget modes, dashboards and UserForm layouts. Its importer is not reused.
inspected: olevba 0.60.2 static analysis and source extraction of xl/vbaProject.bin (42 modules)

Exported vba/*.bas|frm|cls compared with the embedded source: 7 identical after normalisation (attribute/form-header lines removed, trailing whitespace stripped), 16 differ, and 19 exist only in the binary (Test.bas plus 18 empty sheet/workbook modules)
xl/connections.xml, queryTables and the DataMashup M code; external relationships
Sheet inventory: populated sheets include Data Base (775 rows) and Master (113 rows), provenance not documented
executed: Behavioural Python port of SplitCSV, SafeConvertToNumber and the UBound row guard, run with synthetic cases (research/reuse/harness)
findings: SafeConvertToNumber returns 0 for non-numeric input, so invalid input looks the same as a blank or a real 0 (reproduced)
SplitCSV drops a trailing empty field. Combined with the UBound(data) < 8 guard, a withdrawal row whose final deposit column is empty is skipped silently (reproduced)
SplitCSV discards quote characters, so escaped quotes are lost, and it trims whitespace inside quoted fields (reproduced)
Uses CDbl to a Double (inexact money) and a locale-dependent CDate; in a comma-decimal locale, '4.50' becomes 0 (modelled)
olevba reports 'VBA stomping' (an experimental heuristic): the source and p-code differ. Not resolved; this is a reason not to trust the exported .bas files as equivalent to the binary
The embedded Automate/ExtractNumber code differs from the exported version and names real institutions in place of the export's Bank1-3 placeholders
The workbook contains populated rows of undocumented provenance; treat them as potentially personal and never copy them
audit_gaps: VBA-stomping flag not resolved (needs pcodedmp review or a Windows recompile)
Workbook not opened; formulas, pivots and ActiveX behaviour not run
Provenance of the sample data unknown
entries.vendored_note: Only a 49-line excerpt (SplitCSV and SafeConvertToNumber), kept as defect evidence for the harness; it is not code to reuse.

dependency_recommendation.install_policy: Pinned versions with hashes (pip --require-hashes), installed manually by the user or by the 3a setup step after review. No automatic download-and-run scripts.

reuse_from_seed: Ledger plus an import-batch table that records the source account and statement period
Lookup tables with unique name indexes and enforced relationships
DAO BeginTrans/CommitTrans/Rollback around a whole import
reasons: Multi-valued (Taxes) and Attachment (Receipt, CSVFile) fields would need removal for ODBC and privacy, which amounts to a schema rewrite
No statement, due-date, payment-allocation or per-row duplicate-key structures; tax and business categories would need replacing
The importer is per-bank hard-coded VBA with locale-dependent dates, ASCII reads and abrupt End on error
The form code-behind is missing from the template, and it targets Access 2010 (RequiredAccessVersion 14); archived since 2021
access_seed_decision.architecture_retained: Excel frontend + a single authoritative Access .accdb, built by reproducible DDL (task 2b)
